subtitle.en: Apex Executive Governance, Statutory Authorities, and Central Administrative Machinery of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri
subtitle.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ राहुरी चे सर्वोच्च प्रशासकीय संचलन, वैधानिक प्राधिकरणे व मध्यवर्ती प्रशासकीय रचना

text.en: The administration of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is governed under the statutory provisions of the Maharashtra Agricultural Universities (Krishi Vidyapeeths) Act, 1983 and its unified statutes. The Hon. Governor of Maharashtra serves as the Chancellor of the University, and the Hon. Minister for Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra serves as the Pro-Chancellor.
text.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी चे प्रशासन महाराष्ट्र कृषि विद्यापीठे कायदा, १९८३ आणि परिनियमांनुसार चालविले जाते. महाराष्ट्राचे माननीय राज्यपाल हे विद्यापीठाचे कुलपती (Chancellor) असून माननीय कृषिमंत्री हे कुलपती-उपाध्यक्ष (Pro-Chancellor) आहेत.

text.en: The Hon. Vice-Chancellor is the principal executive and academic officer of the University, supported by the Registrar, Comptroller, Director of Research, Director of Extension Education, Dean (Faculty of Agriculture), and University Engineer in carrying out the university mandate of Education, Research, and Extension.
text.mr: माननीय कुलगुरू हे विद्यापीठाचे मुख्य कार्यकारी व शैक्षणिक प्रमुख आहेत. त्यांच्या मार्गदर्शनाखाली कुलसचिव, नियंत्रक (वित्त), संचालक संशोधन, संचालक विस्तार शिक्षण, अधिष्ठाता (कृषि) आणि विद्यापीठ अभियंता हे प्रशासन, संशोधन, शिक्षण व विस्तार कार्याचे प्रभावी संचलन करतात.

introduction.historyEn: The Indian National Agricultural Research System (NARS) with its nationwide network of educational and research institutions consisting of state agricultural universities, zonal research stations, and ICAR institutes established the Agricultural Research Information System (ARIS) in 1996-97 to strengthen research information under the National Agricultural Research Project (NARP). Further, the ARIS Cell was renamed as Agricultural Knowledge Management Unit (AKMU) as per ICAR guidelines (F.No. 3-1/2010-GAS (DIPA) dtd. 27 January, 2011).
introduction.historyMr: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कृषी संशोधन प्रणाली (NARS) अंतर्गत राज्य कृषी विद्यापीठे, विभागीय संशोधन केंद्रे आणि ICAR संस्थांमधील संशोधन माहिती प्रणाली बळकट करण्यासाठी १९९६-९७ मध्ये राष्ट्रीय कृषी संशोधन प्रकल्पांतर्गत (NARP) 'कृषी संशोधन माहिती प्रणाली' (ARIS) कक्षाची स्थापना करण्यात आली. पुढे २७ जानेवारी २०११ च्या ICAR मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वांनुसार (F.No. 3-1/2010-GAS (DIPA)) या कक्षाचे नामकरण 'कृषी ज्ञान व्यवस्थापन केंद्र' (AKMU) असे करण्यात आले.
introduction.infrastructureEn: The Unit is entrusted with developing ICT in agricultural research, maintaining the University's campus network, official website (mpkv.ac.in), centralized server hosting, firewall security, and web server administration. AKMU is connected to all academic, administrative, and research buildings in the central campus through Optical Fibre Cabling (OFC). At present, AKMU is provided with 1 Gbps National Knowledge Network (NKN) internet connectivity (www.nkn.in) through BSNL, shared across all divisions and sections of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri.
introduction.infrastructureMr: कृषी संशोधनात माहिती व संप्रेषण तंत्रज्ञानाचा (ICT) विकास, विद्यापीठाचे अंतर्गत नेटवर्क व्यवस्थापन, अधिकृत संकेतस्थळ (mpkv.ac.in), सर्व्हर होस्टिंग आणि सायबर सुरक्षा यांची जबाबदारी AKMU पार पाडते. मध्यवर्ती आवारातील सर्व इमारती ऑप्टिकल फायबर केबलने (OFC) जोडलेल्या असून BSNL मार्फत १ Gbps क्षमतेची राष्ट्रीय ज्ञान नेटवर्क (NKN) इंटरनेट सुविधा सर्व विभागांना पुरविली जाते.

text.en: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the first State Agriculture University in Maharashtra established in 1969 having its jurisdiction in 10 districts of Western Maharashtra. Director of Instruction shoulders the responsibility of leading the education of the University. Director of Instruction is responsible for preparing the academic programme as regrads to courses offered, curricula and co-ordinate and guide education, in all the constituent and affiliated colleges, technical schools of the University in close co-operation with the Deans of Faculties, Head of Departments and other officers.

Director of Instruction shoulders the responsibility of leading the education of the University. Director of Instruction is responsible for preparing the academic programme as regrads to courses offered, curricula and co-ordinate and guide education, in all the constituent and affiliated colleges, technical schools of the University in close co-operation with the Deans of Faculties, Head of Departments and other officers.

text.en: The mandate is to provide Diploma, Graduate, Post-graduate and Doctorate level quality education in agriculture and allied fields for skill development and producing the competent human resource.
text.mr: The mandate is to provide Diploma, Graduate, Post-graduate and Doctorate level quality education in agriculture and allied fields for skill development and producing the competent human resource.

text.en: The University offers various educational programmes viz., Under graduate [B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B. Tech. (Agricultural Engineering), B.Tech. (Biotechnology), B. Tech. (Food Technology) and B.Sc. (Hons) Agri. Business Management], Post-graduate (M.Sc. (Agri.) and Ph.D.), and Diploma in Agriculture (Agricultural Technology and Polytechnic). The University has fourteen under-graduate constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Kolhapur, Dhule, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar, Halgaon and Kashti, Malegaon; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti, Malegaon; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti, Malegaon; one each agriculture business management and food technology college at Kashti, Malegaon.
text.mr: The University offers various educational programmes viz., Under graduate [B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B. Tech. (Agricultural Engineering), B.Tech. The University has fourteen under-graduate constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Kolhapur, Dhule, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar, Halgaon and Kashti, Malegaon; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti, Malegaon; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti, Malegaon; one each agriculture business management and food technology college at Kashti, Malegaon.

text.en: There is a Post-Graduate Institute and College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology at the Central Campus, Rahuri offering master’s and doctoral programmes in agriculture and agricultural engineering, respectively. The post-graduate programme is also started at College of Agriculture, Pune, Dhule and Kolhapur leading to M.Sc. (Agri.) degree and Ph.D. programme in Agril. Meteorology at College of Agriculture, Pune. The new Post-graduate degree programme in Agricultural Business Management i.e. M.B.A. (Agri.) is started at Colleges of Agriculture, Pune. Additionally, diploma courses are being conducted through 10 constituent and 72 unaided agricultural technology and polytechnic schools with an admission capacity of 4560. Gardener training is also provided through 2 constituent and 3 unaided training centres with an admission capacity of 200.

text.en: During the last decade, successful efforts have been made in improving the course curricula of Under-graduate and Post-graduate programmes. Undergraduate curriculum is revised in line with NEP-2020 as per the VI Deans recommendation, implemented from the year 2024-25. As per the provisions of NEP-2020 revised curriculum includes, flexibility, choice based credit system, multiple entry exit system, skill enhancement courses, internship and Student READY program. Post- graduate programme is revised as per the NCG recommendations, and implemented from the year 2022-23. Constituent colleges provided with additional facilities and amenities viz., ladies hostels, library buildings, tissue culture laboratories and polyhouse facilities. In addition, a Hi-Tech Floriculture and Vegetable Project at Pune and Radioisotope, Biotechnology laboratories, Post-Harvest Management Laboratory and Biodiversity Centre at Rahuri are established.

text.en: Utmost effort has been made in providing quality education with student’s development and amenities with state of art facilities. As a result, since inception University has produced more than one lakh skilled human resource engaged in various public, private and agriculture sectors.
text.mr: Utmost effort has been made in providing quality education with student’s development and amenities with state of art facilities. As a result, since inception University has produced more than one lakh skilled human resource engaged in various public, private and agriculture sectors.

text.en: The students are encouraged for participation in various educational, social and cultural activities. As a result, the students of this University have excelled in various public service competitive examinations, SRF, JRF fellowships, GATE, ARS and extracurricular activities like sports, NCC, NSS etc. In today’s changing climate situation, natural resource degradation, food and nutrition security and its relation to sustainable agriculture and rural development have increasingly become a matter of concern. Thus, agriculture education plays important role for facing such a challenges through use of ICT, weather forecasting, training and transfer new technology. Hope that the young skilled graduates will overcome all these constraints by innovative research and Lab to Land extension of innovations leading to second Green Revolution.

text.en: The University has fifteen constituent colleges out of which eight colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Dhule, Kolhapur, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar Halgaon and Kashti; two agricultural engineering colleges at Rahuri and Kashti; two colleges for horticulture at Pune and Kashti and one each college of Agri. Business Management and Food Technology at Kashti. The University has the Post Graduate Institute at its central campus of Rahuri

description.en: Established in 1907, one of the oldest and most prestigious agricultural colleges in India, situated in Shivajinagar Pune on a historic 150-acre heritage campus.
description.mr: स्थापना १९०७. भारतातील सर्वात जुन्या व नामांकित कृषि महाविद्यालयांपैकी एक. पुण्यातील शिवाजीनगर येथील १५० एकरांच्या ऐतिहासिक संकुलात अत्याधुनिक शैक्षणिक सुविधा.

description.en: Founded in 1960 to serve the Khandesh agricultural belt with excellence in dryland farming, seed production technology, and agronomic research.
description.mr: स्थापना १९६०. खान्देश विभागातील शेती, कोरडवाहू तंत्रज्ञान, बियाणे उत्पादन व दर्जेदार कृषी शिक्षणासाठी अग्रगण्य शासकीय महाविद्यालय.

name.en: Rajarshee Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Government College of Agriculture, Kolhapur
name.mr: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शासकीय कृषि महाविद्यालय, कोल्हापूर

description.en: Established in 1963 on a historic 200-acre lush campus in Kolhapur, specializing in sugarcane production, sub-tropical horticulture, and organic farming.
description.mr: स्थापना १९६३. छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांच्या पावन नगरीतील २०० एकरांचे भव्य संकुल. ऊस उत्पादन तंत्रज्ञान, फलोत्पादन व सेंद्रिय शेतीतील प्रगत शिक्षण केंद्र.

description.en: Dedicated constituent agricultural college established in 2013 catering to the tribal and agrarian youth of the Satpuda mountain tract and northern Maharashtra.
description.mr: स्थापना २०१३. सातपुडा डोंगररांगांतील आदिवासी व ग्रामीण भागातील विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी स्थापन झालेले शासकीय कृषि महाविद्यालय.

description.en: Established in 2013 in the Krishna-Koyna confluence valley at Karad (Dist. Satara), named in honour of Late Yashwantrao Chavan.
description.mr: स्थापना २०१३. कृष्णा-कोयनेच्या प्रीतीसंगमावरील कराड (जि. सातारा) येथे आधुनिक कृषी शिक्षणाची धुरा सांभाळणारे शासकीय महाविद्यालय.

description.en: Modern government constituent campus situated at Muktainagar in Jalgaon district, focusing on banana tissue culture, cotton agronomy, and watershed farming.
description.mr: स्थापना २०१८. जळगाव जिल्ह्यातील मुक्ताईनगर येथे केळी, कापूस, डाळवर्गीय पिके व आधुनिक शेती पद्धतींसाठी सज्ज शासकीय संकुल.

name.en: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government College of Agriculture, Halgaon
name.mr: पुण्यश्लोक अहिल्यादेवी होळकर शासकीय कृषि महाविद्यालय, हळगाव

description.en: Modern constituent campus situated at Halgaon (Tal. Jamkhed, Dist. Ahilyanagar) focused on scarcity zone dryland agriculture, soil conservation, and fodder crops.
description.mr: स्थापना २०१८. जामखेड तालुक्यातील हळगाव (जि. अहिल्यानगर) येथील दुष्काळप्रवण विभागासाठी कोरडवाहू शेती व पशुखाद्य पिकांचे प्रगत केंद्र.

name.en: Government College of Agri. Business Management, Kashti, Malegaon
name.mr: शासकीय कृषि व्यवसाय व्यवस्थापन महाविद्यालय, काष्टी, मालेगाव

description.en: Premier government constituent institution for Agri-Business Management education, supply chain logistics, commodity trading, and rural entrepreneurship.
description.mr: स्थापना २०२१. कृषी व्यवस्थापन, शेतमाल पुरवठा साखळी, बाजारपेठ जोडणी आणि ग्रामीण कृषी उद्योजकतेचे शासकीय महाविद्यालय.

name.en: Government College of Food Technology, Kashti, Malegaon

description.en: Specialized government food technology institute offering state-of-the-art food processing pilot plants, quality assurance labs, and post-harvest technology.
description.mr: स्थापना २०२१. अन्न प्रक्रिया, मूल्यवर्धन, गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण व काढणीपश्चात तंत्रज्ञानातील पदवी देणारे शासकीय महाविद्यालय.

description.en: Dedicated government horticulture institute located on the Shivaji Nagar campus, Pune, training specialists in commercial floriculture, landscape gardening, and protected cultivation.
description.mr: स्थापना २००३. शिवाजीनगर पुणे संकुलातील शासकीय उद्यानविद्या महाविद्यालय. संरक्षित शेती, पुष्पशेती आणि फलोत्पादनातील उच्च शिक्षण.

name.en: Dr. Annasaheb Shinde Government College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, Rahuri
name.mr: डॉ. अण्णासाहेब शिंदे शासकीय कृषि अभियांत्रिकी व तंत्रज्ञान महाविद्यालय, राहुरी

description.en: Established in 1969 at Rahuri Central Campus. Pioneer agricultural engineering institution in Western India producing top farm mechanization engineers and scientists.
description.mr: स्थापना १९६९. राहुरी मध्यवर्ती संकुलातील अग्रगण्य कृषी अभियांत्रिकी महाविद्यालय. ट्रॅक्टर, सिंचन तंत्रज्ञान, ड्रोन व अपारंपरिक ऊर्जेतील संशोधन.

description.en: The apex postgraduate & doctoral research institute of MPKV Rahuri, offering Master's in 17 disciplines and Doctoral degrees in 14 disciplines with national ICAR accreditation.
description.mr: स्थापना १९७२. मफुकृवि राहुरीची सर्वोच्च पदव्युत्तर व डॉक्टरेट संशोधन संस्था. १७ विषयांत एम.एस्सी. व १४ विषयांत पीएच.डी. संशोधन मार्गदर्शन.

name.en: Government College of Agriculture, Kashti, Malegaon

description.en: State-of-the-art multi-disciplinary agricultural campus at Kashti (Tal. Malegaon, Dist. Nashik), established to empower North Maharashtra farmers.
description.mr: स्थापना २०२१. नाशिक जिल्ह्यातील काष्टी (मालेगाव) येथील एकात्मिक कृषी संकुल. द्राक्ष, डाळिंब व आधुनिक शेती पद्धतींचे शिक्षण केंद्र.

name.en: Government College of Horticulture, Kashti, Malegaon

description.en: Specialized constituent horticulture campus at Kashti, dedicated to arid and semi-arid fruit orchards, polyhouse cultivation, and export floriculture.
description.mr: स्थापना २०२१. काष्टी (मालेगाव) येथील शासकीय उद्यानविद्या महाविद्यालय. कोरडवाहू फळबागा, पॉलीहाऊस तंत्रज्ञान व निर्यातक्षम फुलोत्पादन.

name.en: Government College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology, Kashti, Malegaon
name.mr: शासकीय कृषि अभियांत्रिकी व तंत्रज्ञान महाविद्यालय, काष्टी, मालेगाव

description.en: Premier agricultural engineering college at Kashti providing cutting-edge education in micro-irrigation systems, farm machinery robotics, and renewable solar agro-power.
description.mr: स्थापना २०२१. काष्टी (मालेगाव) येथील शासकीय कृषी अभियांत्रिकी महाविद्यालय. सूक्ष्म सिंचन, आधुनिक कृषी यंत्रे आणि सौर ऊर्जेतील पदवी शिक्षण.

text.en: Lower agricultural education was started in Maharashtra before independence of the India. The concept of lower agricultural education revolves around improving the competency of participating students as well as providing trained manpower at the grass root level. In view of this, the Government of Maharashtra has started constituent and affiliated Agricultural Technical School in the state for generation of skilled and trained manpower in field of agriculture.

In view of this, the Government of Maharashtra has started constituent and affiliated Agricultural Technical School in the state for generation of skilled and trained manpower in field of agriculture.

text.en: The division Lower Agricultural Education is headed by Associate Dean who is responsible for maintaining and imparting the quality of Lower Agricultural Education as diploma course.
text.mr: The division Lower Agricultural Education is headed by Associate Dean who is responsible for maintaining and imparting the quality of Lower Agricultural Education as diploma course.

text.en: At present, University has nine constituent and seventy six affiliated Agricultural Technical School. The annul intake capacity is 60 students in each Agricultural Technical School. The students those who passes 10th standard ( S.S.C.) examination are admitted strictly on district merit list in constituent and affiliated Agricultural Technical School. Since inception, the University has produced 60,546 skilled manpower in the lower agricultural education.

text.en: Every year more than 5000 students were admitted to agricultural diploma course.Hence, there is growing unemployment for diploma holders. The remedy lies in reorienting the lower agricultural education and their delivery system so as to produce diploma holders who are job creators rather than job seekers. With the changing social , political and economic structure in our country in different periods, agricultural education also has to undergo changes in its present curricula and its impact to face the rural youth challenges.

text.en: With this view in mind, this University has taken initiatives in restructuring the curriculum of lower agricultural education by including practical oriented subjects such as Seed production, Seed Technology, Organic Farming, Agril. Processing, Farm Mechanization and Irrigation Systems, Plant Production and Fruits and vegetables production Technology etc. with addition of agro based units for skill development in diploma holders .This skilled and young manpower will create self employment and work at grass root level.

text.en: These Diploma course helps to the students to start their own agri-business and act as Agri-entrepreneur. After completion of Diploma course the skilled human resources were developed for agro based industries. This programme act as media for students to make carrier after 10th standard and develop human resource development in agriculture.

This faculty comprises of various 15 departments viz., Agricultural Botany, Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Engineering, Agricultural Entomology, Agricultural Extension & Communication, Agricultural Meteorology, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry and Dairy Science, Biochemistry, Food Science and Technology, Horticulture, Interfaculty Department of Irrigation Water Management, Plant Pathology and Agricultural Microbiology, Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry and Statistics.

This faculty comprises of various 15 departments viz., Agricultural Botany, Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Engineering, Agricultural Entomology, Agricultural Extension & Communication, Agricultural Meteorology, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry and Dairy Science, Biochemistry, Food Science and Technology, Horticulture, Interfaculty Department of Irrigation Water Management, Plant Pathology and Agricultural Microbiology, Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry and Statistics.
text.mr: Faculty of Agricultural Science is one of the faculties of the University. text.en: This faculty is responsible for the various academic programmes viz., under graduate [B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B. Tech (Bio Technology), B. faqs.qEn: When and how should university pensioners submit the annual Life Certificate (हयातीचा दाखला)?
faqs.qMr: विद्यापीठ निवृत्तीवेतनधारकांनी वार्षिक हयातीचा दाखला कधी व कसा सादर करावा?
faqs.aEn: Every retiree or family pensioner must submit the Life Certificate in the month of November each year. It can be submitted physically at the Pension Cell / disbursing bank branch, or digitally through the Government of India Jeevan Pramaan portal using biometric Aadhaar authentication.
faqs.aMr: सर्व निवृत्तीवेतनधारक व कुटुंब निवृत्तीवेतनधारकांनी दरवर्षी १ ते ३० नोव्हेंबर दरम्यान हयातीचा दाखला सादर करणे अनिवार्य आहे. हा दाखला प्रत्यक्ष बँकेत अथवा पेन्शन कक्षात जाऊन किंवा 'जीवन प्रमाण' (Jeevan Pramaan) पोर्टलद्वारे बायोमेट्रिक आधारे डिजिटल स्वरूपात सादर करता येतो.

faqs.qEn: What is the procedure for obtaining up to 40% Commutation of Pension?
faqs.qMr: निवृत्तीवेतनाचे ४०% पर्यंत अंशराशीकरण (Commutation) मिळविण्याची काय पद्धत आहे?
faqs.aEn: An employee retiring on superannuation may apply for commutation up to 40% of basic pension within one year of retirement without medical examination. The application in the prescribed format should be submitted to the Pension Cell through the respective Head of Office.
faqs.aMr: वयोमर्यादेनुसार सेवानिवृत्त होणारा कर्मचारी सेवानिवृत्तीच्या १ वर्षाच्या आत वैद्यकीय तपासणीशिवाय कमाल ४०% पर्यंत मूळ निवृत्तीवेतनाचे अंशराशीकरण करू शकतो. यासाठी विहित नमुन्यातील अर्ज संबंधित कार्यालय प्रमुखांमार्फत नियंत्रक कार्यालयातील पेन्शन कक्षाकडे सादर करावा लागतो.

faqs.qEn: How is the General Provident Fund (GPF) final balance settled after retirement?
faqs.qMr: सेवानिवृत्तीनंतर भविष्य निर्वाह निधी (GPF) ची अंतिम शिल्लक रक्कम कशी मिळते?
faqs.aEn: Three months prior to the date of retirement, the employee should submit Form 'B' along with the last credit slip to the Comptroller Office. The final payment order including up-to-date interest is issued promptly on the date of superannuation.
faqs.aMr: सेवानिवृत्तीच्या दिनांकापूर्वी ३ महिने अगोदर कर्मचाऱ्याने विहित 'ब' नमुन्यातील अर्ज व चालू आर्थिक वर्षाचे वर्गणी विवरण पत्रक नियंत्रक कार्यालयास सादर करावे. सेवानिवृत्तीच्या दिवशी संपूर्ण व्याजासह अंतिम रकमेचा धनादेश/खात्यात हस्तांतरण आदेश जारी केला जातो.

faqs.qEn: What are the deadlines and proforma for Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APAR)?
faqs.qMr: वार्षिक गोपनीय अहवाल (APAR) सादर करण्याची मुदत व कार्यपद्धती काय आहे?
faqs.aEn: Every employee must submit their self-appraisal by 15th April for the preceding financial year. The Reporting Officer completes evaluation by 31st May, and the Reviewing Authority finalizes grades by 30th June for inclusion in the official dossier.
faqs.aMr: प्रत्येक कर्मचाऱ्याने वित्तीय वर्ष संपल्यानंतर १५ एप्रिलपर्यंत आपला स्वयंकूल्यांकन अहवाल सादर करणे आवश्यक आहे. प्रतिवेदन अधिकाऱ्याने ३१ मे पर्यंत व पुनर्विलोकन अधिकाऱ्याने ३० जूनपर्यंत मूल्यमापन पूर्ण करून कुलसचिव आस्थापना विभागाकडे सादर करणे बंधनकारक असते.

agrescoProceedings.descriptionMr: पिक सुधारणा, नवीन वाणांची शिफारस, सेंद्रिय व नैसर्गिक शेती, सूक्ष्म सिंचन व कृषी अवजारे यावरील सर्वंकष शिफारशींचे अधिकृत कार्यवृत्त.

agrescoProceedings.descriptionEn: Landmark 50th state research council proceedings documenting 50 years of agricultural technology evolution and climate-smart agriculture recommendations.
agrescoProceedings.descriptionMr: ५० व्या सुवर्ण महोत्सवी संयुक्त अग्रेस्को परिषदेतील ऐतिहासिक तंत्रज्ञान आढावा व शेती शिफारशी.

agrescoProceedings.descriptionEn: Approved technical recommendations for drip fertigation, bio-fertilizers, integrated pest management, and post-harvest value addition.
agrescoProceedings.descriptionMr: ठिबक सिंचन, खत व्यवस्थापन, एकात्मिक कीड नियंत्रण व काढणीपश्चात तंत्रज्ञान शिफारशी.

agrescoProceedings.descriptionEn: Official state proceedings containing recommendations for farm implements, seed production technologies, and variety releases.

foundationDay.titleMr: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ वर्धापन दिन (२९ मार्च)
foundationDay.descriptionEn: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri was established on March 29, 1968 under the Maharashtra Agricultural Universities Act. Every year, March 29th is celebrated with immense fervor as Foundation Day, honoring progressive farmers, distinguished scientists, and alumni achievers.
foundationDay.descriptionMr: महाराष्ट्र कृषी विद्यापीठ कायद्यान्वये २९ मार्च १९६८ रोजी महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठाची स्थापना झाली. दरवर्षी २९ मार्च हा दिवस विद्यापीठ वर्धापन दिन म्हणून अत्यंत उत्साहात साजरा केला जातो. याप्रसंगी आदर्श शेतकरी, उत्कृष्ट शास्त्रज्ञ व गुणवंत विद्यार्थ्यांचा सत्कार केला जातो.

vanmohotsav.titleEn: Van Mahotsav & Green Campus Afforestation Mission
vanmohotsav.titleMr: वनमहोत्सव व हरित परिसर संवर्धन मोहीम
vanmohotsav.descriptionEn: MPKV Central Campus spreads across 7,855 hectares in Rahuri, incorporating sustainable agroforestry, shelterbelts, indigenous teak, neem, and sandalwood plantations. Every July during Van Mahotsav, university students, faculty, and farm workers plant over 50,000 indigenous trees to combat climate change and maintain biodiversity.
vanmohotsav.descriptionMr: राहुरी मध्यवर्ती आवार ७,८५५ हेक्टरवर पसरलेले असून दरवर्षी जुलै महिन्यात वनमहोत्सवाचे औचित्य साधून ५० हजारांहून अधिक वृक्षांची लागवड केली जाते. यामध्ये बांबू, सागवान, कडुलिंब, आवळा, चिंच व औषधी वनस्पतींचे आगार तयार करण्यात आले आहे.

milestones.eventMr: मिशन अमृत वन व कृषी-वनिकी मोहीम

retrospection.descriptionEn: MAGOVA is a premier annual introspection convention organized at the Central Campus, Rahuri during late December / first week of January. The Vice Chancellor, Directors, Deans, and Heads of Departments review annual progress in education, varietal development, externally funded research, technology transfer, and administrative reforms.
retrospection.descriptionMr: 'मगोवा' ही विद्यापीठाची वार्षिक सर्वंकष विचारमंथन परिषद असून दरवर्षी डिसेंबर अखेर अथवा जानेवारीच्या पहिल्या आठवड्यात आयोजित केली जाते. यामध्ये शिक्षण, संशोधन, विस्तार शिक्षण, कृषी अभियांत्रिकी व प्रशासनातील प्रगतीचा सूक्ष्म आढावा घेऊन आगामी वर्षाचे धोरण ठरविले जाते.

kisanAadhar.descriptionEn: Kisan Aadhar Sammelan is a flagship mega state farmers convention organized annually since 2017 jointly by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri and the Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (along with ATMA Ahmednagar). It features high-tech agricultural exhibitions, live crop demonstrations, cattle shows, farmers-scientists interaction workshops, and seed distribution.
kisanAadhar.descriptionMr: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी आणि कृषी विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन (व आत्मा अहमदनगर) यांच्या संयुक्त विद्यमाने २०१७ पासून भव्य 'किसान आधार संमेलन' आयोजित केले जाते. यामध्ये अत्याधुनिक कृषी प्रदर्शन, विविध पिकांचे जिवंत प्रक्षेत्र प्रात्यक्षिके, पशुप्रदर्शन, शेतकरी-शास्त्रज्ञ चर्चासत्रे व उन्नत बी-बियाणे वाटप केले जाते.

editions.descriptionEn: Held at Central Campus Rahuri with over 150,000 farmers participating across Maharashtra. Featured live crop demonstrations, cattle show, innovative machinery, and crop-specific technical seminars.
editions.descriptionMr: राहुरी मध्यवर्ती आवार येथे आयोजित. राज्यभरातून १.५ लाखांहून अधिक शेतकरी सहभागी. विविध पिकांची प्रात्यक्षिके, पशुप्रदर्शन व शास्त्रज्ञांची मार्गदर्शन सत्रे.

documents.titleMr: किसान आधार संमेलन २०१८ तांत्रिक चर्चासत्रे कार्यक्रम

editions.descriptionEn: Organized under the theme 'New India Manthan — Sankalp Se Siddhi, Unnat Sheti - Samruddha Shetkari' in collaboration with ATMA Ahmednagar. Grand state-level technology display and farmers convention.
editions.descriptionMr: 'न्यू इंडिया मंथन — संकल्प से सिद्धी, उन्नत शेती - समृद्ध शेतकरी' या संकल्पनेखाली आत्मा अहमदनगरच्या सहकार्याने आयोजित. भव्य कृषी तंत्रज्ञान प्रदर्शन.

text.en: State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra and Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER) Pune are jointly organizes Joint AGRESCO every year on rotational basis. Recently, 47th Joint AGRESCO Meet was organized at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyappeeth, Rahuri on 29-31 May, 2019. The inaugural function was Chaired by Dr. K. P. Viswanath, Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri while Shri Chandrakant Patil, Hon’ble Minister of Revenue, Agriculture, PWD (excluding undertakings) and Relief & Rehabilitation of Maharashtra State was the Chairman for concluding session. In 47th Joint AGRESCO Meet 2019, 08 crop varieties, 01 farm implement and machineries, and 5 abiotic resistant sources of plant varieties and 47 production technologies developed by Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri were accepted and release for benefits of farming community.

In context of pandemic spread of COVID-19 disease, 48th Joint AGRESCO Meet was organized on virtual mode during on 27-31 October, 2020. The valedictory function was Chaired by Shri Dadajee Bhuse, Hon’ble Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra State. text.en: The 51st Joint Agresco meet -2023 of four SAUs in Maharashtra was organized at MPKV, Rahuri during May 25-27, 2023. The function was inaugurated by Shri Abdul Sattar, Hon’ble State Minister of Agriculture. Dr. Parimal Singh(IAS), Hon’ble Project Director, PoCRA was the chief guest. Vice- Chancellors of all SAUs of Maharashtra were present for this meeting. University scientists presented their recommendations. In all MPKV has given 69 recommendations, released 5 varieties & 3 farm implements. Directorate of Extension Education, MPKV, Rahuri has organized Agril. Exibition to showcase the University technology. All departments of four SAUs in Maharashtra participated in Agril. exhibition and showcased their activities.

text.en: A Green Campus and Clan Campus is a place where environmental friendly practices and education combine to promote sustainable and eco-friendly practices in the campus. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is incorporating these strategies into the institutional planning processes with the aim of develop a clean and green campus. On this line this university is celebrating 1st July as a Krishidin and also organizing the massive tree plantation programme under the university jurisdiction every year. The tree plantation initiative includes neem, jamun, mango, bamboo, karanj, aonla, hirda, behada, kagzi lime and various medicinal plants.

text.en: A massive tree plantation programme Vanmohotsav -2017 and Krishidin was organized on July 01, 2017 at MPKV, Rahuri. The programme was chaired by Dr. K. P. Viswanatha, Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri. Dr. V. P. Chahal, ADG (AE), ICAR, New Delhi, Dr. Lakhan Singh, Director, ICAR-ATARI, Zone-VIII, Pune were the chief guests. Dr. K. D. Kokate, Director, Extension Education, Dr. R.S. Patil, Director of Research and other university authorities guided the scientists, staff, students. In all 52 Plantation Groups were formed and more than one thousand University staff including scientists, supporting staff etc. participated in the plantation programme.

text.en: A massive tree plantation programme Vanmohotsav -2018 and Krishidin was organized on July 02, 2018 at the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri to celebrate the birth anniversary of former Chief Minister of Maharashtra late Vasantrao Naik. Dr. K. P. Viswanatha, Vice Chancellor, MPKV, Rahuri presided over the function. Shri. Adarsha Reddy, District Conservator of Forests, Ahmednagar was the chief guest. Dr. K. D. Kokate, Director, Extension Education, Dr. S. R. Gadakh, Director of Research, Mrs. Kirti Jamdhade, Divisional Forest Officer, Shri. Anil Dound, Tahsildar, Rahuri, Registrar Dr. D. D. Pawar, Comptroller Shri. Vijay Kote, Shri. Pandit Lonare, District Superintendent Agricultural Officer, Ahmednagar were present for the programme. After the programme, the university staff and students planted around 23,655 trees at the central campus. These include neem, jamun, mango, bamboo, karanj, aonla, hirda, behada, kagzi lime and various medicinal plants. A target of 1,06,182 trees for planting this year has been set by the university in its ten district jurisdiction.

Ranpise, Director of Extension Education, Dr. C.S. Patil, Registrar Dr. V.S. Shirke, Comptroller, Shri. V.T. Patil, University Engg. Shri M.P. Dhoke and Mrs. Shubhangi Dhote Madam, Forest Dept. text.en: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.
text.mr: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.

text.en: The Farmer FIRST as a concept of ICAR is developed as farmer in a centric role for research problem identification, prioritization and conduct of experiments and its management in farmers’ conditions. The focus is on farmer’s Farm, Innovations, Resources, Science and Technology (FIRST). Two terms ‘enriching knowledge’ and ‘integrating technology’ qualify the meaning of Farmer FIRST in Indian context. Enriching knowledge signifies the need for the research system as well as farmers to learn from each other in context to existing farm environment, perception of each other and interactions with the sub-systems established around. Technology integration is looked from the perspective that the scientific outputs coming out from the research institutions, many times do not fit as such in the farmers’ conditions and thus, certain alterations and adaptations are required at field level for their acceptance, adoption and success.

text.en: The project entitled “Socio-economic Empowerment of Farmers through Farming System Interventions for Sustainable Agriculture Development in Ahmednagar District” under ICAR Farmer FIRST Programme is being implemented by the university since 2016-17. The project focuses on the Integrated Farming System (IFS) modules and is being implemented in chinchvihire and Kangar Villages of Ahmednagar district. Around 750 farm families are involved in this programme. The various IFS components include pulses and cereals production technologies, horticultural crops along with dairy management, farm pond fishery, goatry and backyard poultry. This would lead to increasing crop productivity and income. This technology application approach need to be out scaled and up scaled for the benefit of both research and extension system.

text.en: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.
text.mr: The Farmer FIRST Programme (FFP) is an ICAR initiative to move beyond the production and productivity, to privilege the smallholder agriculture and complex, diverse and risk prone realities of majority of the farmers through enhancing farmers-scientists interface. There are concepts and domains that are new in emphasis like resource management, climate resilient agriculture, production management including storage, market, supply chains, value chains, innovation systems, information systems, etc.

text.en: The Farmer FIRST as a concept of ICAR is developed as farmer in a centric role for research problem identification, prioritization and conduct of experiments and its management in farmers’ conditions. The focus is on farmer’s Farm, Innovations, Resources, Science and Technology (FIRST). Two terms ‘enriching knowledge’ and ‘integrating technology’ qualify the meaning of Farmer FIRST in Indian context. Enriching knowledge signifies the need for the research system as well as farmers to learn from each other in context to existing farm environment, perception of each other and interactions with the sub-systems established around. Technology integration is looked from the perspective that the scientific outputs coming out from the research institutions, many times do not fit as such in the farmers’ conditions and thus, certain alterations and adaptations are required at field level for their acceptance, adoption and success.

text.en: The project entitled “Socio-economic Empowerment of Farmers through Farming System Interventions for Sustainable Agriculture Development in Ahmednagar District” under ICAR Farmer FIRST Programme is being implemented by the university since 2016-17. The project focuses on the Integrated Farming System (IFS) modules and is being implemented in chinchvihire and Kangar Villages of Ahmednagar district. Around 750 farm families are involved in this programme. The various IFS components include pulses and cereals production technologies, horticultural crops along with dairy management, farm pond fishery, goatry and backyard poultry. This would lead to increasing crop productivity and income. This technology application approach need to be out scaled and up scaled for the benefit of both research and extension system.

text.en: MPKV has pioneered in rural development and extension of new agricultural technologies to the farmers since its establishment. Extension education is one of the important mandates of the university. The Directorate of Extension Education was started in the year 1981 for the planning and execution of programmes of extension work based on the results of research and work in cooperation with the other Directorates of the University.
text.mr: MPKV has pioneered in rural development and extension of new agricultural technologies to the farmers since its establishment. Extension education is one of the important mandates of the university. The Directorate of Extension Education was started in the year 1981 for the planning and execution of programmes of extension work based on the results of research and work in cooperation with the other Directorates of the University.

text.en: The Directorate of Extension Education supervises and controls all extension education activities of the University. The Directorate of Extension Education, in close consultation with the Government Development Departments and other allied departments is responsible to provide them with the improved research findings of the University and cause to publish extension bulletins, circulars, news article and press release which summarize important research findings of benefits to the farming community.

The Directorate of Extension Education, in close consultation with the Government Development Departments and other allied departments is responsible to provide them with the improved research findings of the University and cause to publish extension bulletins, circulars, news article and press release which summarize important research findings of benefits to the farming community.

text.en: The Directorate performs activities like co-ordination of extension education activities in the jurisdiction of University. The Directorate through its various units viz., Agricultural Technology Information Centers (01), Regional Extension Centers (04), District Extension Centers (05) and Krishi Vigyan Kendras (17) performs this pivotal activity by organizing on campus and off campus extension programmes viz., Training programmes, FLDs, Farmers Rallies, Field Visits, Diagnostic Team Visits, On Farm Trials, Exhibitions, Field days etc. for transfer of technologies and collecting feed back.

text.en:
The Agricultural Technology Information Center (ATIC) is single window delivery dissemination and supporting system for various innovative and farm worthy techniques evolved at the university and affiliated organization in the pursuit of research and excellence. This Center started its actual functioning w.e.f. 13th August, 2001 with the following objectives.To empower farmers through direct access to information and knowledge.To create strong linkage between different research divisions, units and user of technology.To help farmers in problem solving and decision making.To facilitate and dynamic feed forward and feed back mechanism.To bridge the gap between attainable and attained in the crop, livestock development and production.To generate financial resources through sales and services.To disseminate the new technologies developed by the University through organizing Farmers Rallies, Field Visits and
                            Agril. Exhibitions.
text.mr:
The Agricultural Technology Information Center (ATIC) is single window delivery dissemination and supporting system for various innovative and farm worthy techniques evolved at the university and affiliated organization in the pursuit of research and excellence. This Center started its actual functioning w.e.f. 13th August, 2001 with the following objectives.To empower farmers through direct access to information and knowledge.To create strong linkage between different research divisions, units and user of technology.To help farmers in problem solving and decision making.To facilitate and dynamic feed forward and feed back mechanism.To bridge the gap between attainable and attained in the crop, livestock development and production.To generate financial resources through sales and services.To disseminate the new technologies developed by the University through organizing Farmers Rallies, Field Visits and
                            Agril. Exhibitions.

text.en: The ATIC is supervised by the Manager with four subject matter specialists (SMS) from the disciplines viz., Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant protection and Animal husbandry and Dairy and Public Relation Officer (PRO). The extension activities like field visits, replying the queries of the farmers and other stakeholders and the center performs diagnostic services in coordination with the other departments of University. Besides, the seed and seedlings, processed products and publications are also sold through ATIC to the end users.

It was envisaged in the project planning that the activities be undertaken with the State resources after five years. The Center was established for effective use of mass media in transfer of technology. The public Relation Unit of the Communication Center entertains farmers’ visitors and other dignitaries.

text.en: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), New Delhi has started the Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs) in all 10 districts under jurisdiction of the university. In all total 17 KVKs are in operation in various districts of western Maharashtra. Out of the 17 KVKs 4 are directly under administrative control of the university, while, others are run by different NGOs and other institutes.

text.en: Regional Extension Centers established in the year 2002 to test and transfer the improved technology from time to time in adjoining areas of respective research and educational institutes. Three RECs are started at the constituent colleges, viz., Pune, Dhule and Kolhapur and one at Central Campus, MPKV, Rahuri. Regional Extension Center consists of four SMS in the subject of Agronomy, Animal Husbandary, Horticulture and Plant protection. The activities of each REC are governed by Extension Agronomist at regional level, which is technically controlled by Director of Extension Education.To organize short duration training classes for up-gradation of knowledge of existing staff.To arrange farmers trainings for solving the problems in farming.To interact with farmers and officers for getting feed back on research findings.To arrange monthly meetings of different allied departments and interact on various field problems.To integrate teaching, research and extension education activities.
text.mr: Regional Extension Centers established in the year 2002 to test and transfer the improved technology from time to time in adjoining areas of respective research and educational institutes. Three RECs are started at the constituent colleges, viz., Pune, Dhule and Kolhapur and one at Central Campus, MPKV, Rahuri. Regional Extension Center consists of four SMS in the subject of Agronomy, Animal Husbandary, Horticulture and Plant protection. The activities of each REC are governed by Extension Agronomist at regional level, which is technically controlled by Director of Extension Education.To organize short duration training classes for up-gradation of knowledge of existing staff.To arrange farmers trainings for solving the problems in farming.To interact with farmers and officers for getting feed back on research findings.To arrange monthly meetings of different allied departments and interact on various field problems.To integrate teaching, research and extension education activities.

text.en: The staff under the RECs usually undertakes activities relating to transfer of technology in the adjacent areas. The activities like, monthly district workshops, fortnightly trainings, demonstrations on farmers fields, farmers’ rallies and technical guidance to farmers are also organized by the Center.

text.en: Every Regional Extension Centers are provided a Mobile Crop Dispensary Van with the facilities to undertake soil and water analysis, diagnosis of diseases, insect, pest instantly on the spot in different villages. The fix route of this activity is announced and communicated well in advance to the farmers of respective villages and accordingly the farmers avail the guidance and necessary help to solve their problems.

text.en: The faculty of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri comprises over 800 accomplished professors, scientists, and agricultural specialists engaged across 10 constituent colleges, the Post Graduate Institute (PGI), and 27 research stations. The faculty is organized under major disciplines including Agronomy, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Soil Science, Horticulture, Entomology, Plant Pathology, Agricultural Engineering, and Extension Education.
text.mr: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ, राहुरी मध्ये १० घटक महाविद्यालये, पदव्युत्तर संस्था (PGI) आणि २७ संशोधन केंद्रांमध्ये ८०० हून अधिक प्राध्यापक, शास्त्रज्ञ व विषय विशेषज्ञ कार्यरत आहेत. कृषिविज्ञान, वनस्पती पैदास, मृदविज्ञान, उद्यानविद्या, कीटकशास्त्र, वनस्पती रोगशास्त्र, कृषि अभियांत्रिकी व विस्तार शिक्षण अशा प्रमुख शाखांमध्ये हे तज्ज्ञ अध्यापन व संशोधन करतात.

text.en: To facilitate global research collaboration and scientific transparency, detailed individual academic profiles, publications, h-index citations, and patents of all MPKV faculty members are cataloged on the official National IRINS (Indian Research Information Network System) Portal at mpkv.irins.org.
text.mr: संशोधनातील पारदर्शकता व जागतिक सहकार्यासाठी सर्व प्राध्यापकांची वैयक्तिक संशोधक प्रोफाइल, शोधनिबंध, h-index उद्धरणे आणि पेटंट्स राष्ट्रीय आयरिन्स (IRINS - Vidwan) प्रणालीवर mpkv.irins.org येथे ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध आहेत.

text.en: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठाच्या संशोधन प्रक्रियेतून निर्माण झालेले सुधारित कृषि तंत्रज्ञान, शेतकरी आणि शास्त्रज्ञ यांच्या योग्य समन्वयातून प्रसारीत केले तर त्याचे अवलंबन शेतकरी स्तरावर मोठया प्रमाणावर होऊन कृषिविकासाला चालना मिळेल, याच संकल्पनेतून विस्तार कार्याला बळकटीकरण येण्यासाठी 11 ऑक्टोबर, 2005 पासून हाती घेतलेला आहे. महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ अंतर्गत संशोधन केंद्रे, कृषि महाविद्यालये आणि कृषि तंत्र विद्यालये येथे एकुण 54 शेतकरी - शास्त्रज्ञ मंचाची स्थापना केली असून एकूण 1668 सभासद याचा लाभ घेत आहेत.

text.en: महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठाच्या संशोधन प्रक्रियेतून निर्माण झालेले सुधारित कृषि तंत्रज्ञान, शेतकरी आणि शास्त्रज्ञ यांच्या योग्य समन्वयातून प्रसारीत केले तर त्याचे अवलंबन शेतकरी स्तरावर मोठया प्रमाणावर होऊन कृषिविकासाला चालना मिळेल, याच संकल्पनेतून विस्तार कार्याला बळकटीकरण येण्यासाठी 11 ऑक्टोबर, 2005 पासून हाती घेतलेला आहे. महात्मा फुले कृषि विद्यापीठ अंतर्गत संशोधन केंद्रे, कृषि महाविद्यालये आणि कृषि तंत्र विद्यालये येथे एकुण 54 शेतकरी - शास्त्रज्ञ मंचाची स्थापना केली असून एकूण 1668 सभासद याचा लाभ घेत आहेत.

desc.en: Function as the Internal Auditor of the Vidyapeeth and ensure all orders involving financial implications are issued only after his concurrence.

text.en: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.
text.mr: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.

text.en: The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in 1969. Later on in 1972, four agricultural universities were established in Maharashtra. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is one of them established in 1969 for the western Maharashtra having jurisdiction spread over 10 districts viz. Jalgaon, Nandurbar, Dhule, Nashik, Ahmednagar,Pune, Solapur, Satara, Sangli and Kolhapur. The University is named after the great social reformer "Mahatma Jyotiba Phule".

text.en: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.
text.mr: The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education. In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning in March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai.

text.en: The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in 1969. Later on in 1972, four agricultural universities were established in Maharashtra. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is one of them established in 1969 for the western Maharashtra having jurisdiction spread over 10 districts viz. Jalgaon, Nandurbar, Dhule, Nashik, Ahmednagar,Pune, Solapur, Satara, Sangli and Kolhapur. The University is named after the great social reformer "Mahatma Jyotiba Phule".

text.en: The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) was formulated at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri in March, 2014. As per directives of MCAER, Pune the Internal Quality Assurance Cell was revised as Internal Quality Assessment Cell and its composition was changed as per following table.
text.mr: The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) was formulated at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri in March, 2014. As per directives of MCAER, Pune the Internal Quality Assurance Cell was revised as Internal Quality Assessment Cell and its composition was changed as per following table.

text.en: The IQAC acts as the documentation and record-keeping cell for the institution including assistance in the development of the API (Academic Performance Indicator) criteria as per PBAS (Performance Based Appraisal System), proforma using the indicative template separately developed according to UGC Rules and regulations common to all teaching / research staff members in the jurisdiction of the University. The IQAC scrutinizes all cases of promotion through Career Advancement Scheme and scrutinizes the applications submitted by the University Officers for the various posts outside University as per requirement.

text.en: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is one of the best universities among Maharashtra with a mandate of agricultural education, research and extension. Libraries play pivotal role in dissemination of knowledge and information to the students, readers in their education, research and extension activities. In order to cater the needs of the readers, the University Library, started functioning at Central Campus in the year 1968 with a merge collection of 2070 books only. It is developing steadily under the able guidance of Vice-Chancellor and Chairmanship of Library Advisory Committee and rendering various services to the readers, scientists, teachers, students etc. since last fifty years.

In order to cater the needs of the readers, the University Library, started functioning at Central Campus in the year 1968 with a merge collection of 2070 books only. It is developing steadily under the able guidance of Vice-Chancellor and Chairmanship of Library Advisory Committee and rendering various services to the readers, scientists, teachers, students etc. since last fifty years.

text.en: Due to huge collection of books and documents, a beautiful and impressive separate building was constructed in 1980 with 3740 sq.mt. Carpet area. The library was shifted in the newly constructed building in December, 1980. The building is having length of 117 ft and the width of 130 ft. Extension of University Library building completed from the 100 crores grants received by ICAR in 2012. Two Sections viz: Reference Section & Theses Section shifted in new extended building by which sitting capacity of 150 readers increased. The University Library is kept open for usages from 9.00 to 21.00 hrs throughout the years except Sundays and Holidays. The University Library has also provided Reading Room Facility to the students, which is kept open from 9.00 to 23.00 hrs.

text.en: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).
text.mr: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).

text.en: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.

The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.

text.en: The Governor of Maharashtra state is the Chancellor of the University, The Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra state is the Pro-Chancellor, while, Vice-Chancellor is the Head of the University. The Executive Council is the highest policy making body of the University. The Vice-Chancellor is the Chairman of this Council. The Council constitutes of nominated peoples representatives, eminent members from agriculture and development departments, scientists, representative of ICAR and progressive farmers. The University is assisted by Academic Council, Agricultural Research Council, Extension Education Council for co-ordination and review of academic, research and extension education programmes, seed production and agricultural development programmes.

text.en: The University has seven constituent colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Kolhapur, Dhule, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar and Halgaon; one agricultural engineering college at Rahuri and one college for horticulture at Pune. The University also governs academically the 63 constituent colleges of agricultural science, agricultural engineering, food technology, bio-technology, agricultural business management in its jurisdiction. All these colleges offer the Graduate degree programmes. The combined intake capacity is 5574.

text.en: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).
text.mr: Before the period of independence and during few years after independence, the non-agricultural universities were entrusted with the responsibility of agricultural education and the State Department of Agriculture contributed to research and extension. The agricultural universities were established in this country from 1960 according to the recommendations of Radhakrishnan Commission (1948).

text.en: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.
text.mr: In pursuance of the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) Act 1967, initially, the Maharashtra Agricultural University (Krishi Vidyapeeth) was established for the entire Maharashtra State and started functioning from 29 March, 1968 with its office at Mumbai. The office was shifted to College of Agriculture, Pune in the year 1969. Subsequently in the same year, two agricultural universities and in 1972, two more agricultural universities were established. Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth (MPKV), Rahuri is one of them which was established in 1969 for the Western Maharashtra with its jurisdiction spread over ten districts namely, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur, Ahmednagar, Solapur, Pune, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon and Nandurbar. The University is named after the great social reformer Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri is the premier Agricultural University in Maharashtra that renders services to the farmers through Education, Research and Extension Education.

text.en: The Governor of Maharashtra state is the Chancellor of the University, The Minister of Agriculture, Maharashtra state is the Pro-Chancellor, while, Vice-Chancellor is the Head of the University. The Executive Council is the highest policy making body of the University. The Vice-Chancellor is the Chairman of this Council. The Council constitutes of nominated peoples representatives, eminent members from agriculture and development departments, scientists, representative of ICAR and progressive farmers. The University is assisted by Academic Council, Agricultural Research Council, Extension Education Council for co-ordination and review of academic, research and extension education programmes, seed production and agricultural development programmes.

text.en: The University has seven constituent colleges of agriculture sciences located at Pune, Kolhapur, Dhule, Nandurbar, Karad, Muktainagar and Halgaon; one agricultural engineering college at Rahuri and one college for horticulture at Pune. The University also governs academically the 63 constituent colleges of agricultural science, agricultural engineering, food technology, bio-technology, agricultural business management in its jurisdiction. All these colleges offer the Graduate degree programmes. The combined intake capacity is 5574.

text.en: The University has 27 research stations in 5 agro-climatic zones including 4 State level Crop Specialists, 4 Zonal Agricultural Research Stations and 17 Strategic and Verification Research Centres to conduct research programme on different aspects. Further the University currently implement 82 non-plan schemes funded by State Government, 45 All India Co-ordinated Research Projects (AICRPs) on different crops/plant sciences sponsored by Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), New Delhi; and one Centrally Sponsored Research Schemes funded by the Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India.

text.en: The Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation Cell has been functioning since May 2018. The major focus of this PME Cell is to plan and monitor various development programmes and activities of the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth. The PME Cell acts as a coordination unit between the University and Government Departments of Maharashtra State. The PME Cell processes the new research scheme proposals of the University in getting funds for infrastructure development and facilitates implementation of various schemes for the benefit of the farming community. It is also involved scruitinizing award, training, conferences, workshop and seminar proposals of scientists and faculties for onward submission. The PME Cell is under development. Various activities have been initiated for implementation in the university. The cell has developed various formats for proposals regarding projects, to attend conferences, seminars, training and workshops. The university vision document, infrastructure plan, student database is being prepared. The PME Cell has prepared guidelines regarding attending conferences and trainings by scientists and faculties. The PME Cell is working towards quality planning, research, and monitoring of research, education and extension education activities. The PME Cell office is in administration building of the university and near the office of Directorate of Rsearch. The PME Cell office is in administration building of the university.

text.mr: Dr A.S. College of Agril. Engg. & Tech., Rahuri

text.en: The university has a very good network of 27 research stations spread over 5 different agro-climatic zones having 82 non-plan schemes funded by State Govt., 45 AICRPs on different crops /plant sciences and one Centrally Sponsored Research Schemes funded by the Central Govt., Ministry of Agriculture, where varietal development and technology verification of more than 100 crops (cereals, pulses, oilseeds, vegetable , cash crops protected cultivation , exotic vegetables and fruit crops) is being carried out. In addition to this management of natural resource management, development of integrated farming system model research is undertaken for the upliftment of resource poor farming community.
text.mr: पश्चिम महाराष्ट्रातील दहा जिल्हयांचा समावेश असलेले घाट विभाग, उप-पर्वतीय विभाग, मैदानी विभाग, अवर्षण प्रवण विभाग व मध्य महाराष्ट्रातील पठारी विभाग या 5 हवामान विभागात असलेली तृणधान्‍ये, कडधान्‍ये, गळीताची धान्‍ये, फळे-भाजीपाला, नगदी पिके, विदेशी भाजीपाला इत्‍यादी १०० हून अधिक पिकावर, मध्यवर्ती परिसरासह एकूण 27 संशोधन केंद्रावर असलेल्‍या राज्य शासन अनुदानित 82 योजनेतर योजना, भारतीय कृषि संशोधन परिषद (75 %) आणि राज्य शासन (25 %) अनुदानीत 45 अखिल भारतीय समन्वीत संशोधन प्रकल्प आणि केंद्र पुरस्कृत 100 टक्के अनुदानीत 1 संशोधन प्रकल्पामार्फत संशोधन केले जाते.

text.en: To improve production and productivity of cereals, pulses, oilseeds, sugarcane, cotton, fruits, vegetables, flowers and farm animals. To conserve natural resources and improve their efficiency for sustainable production of crops and animal produce. Conservation of genetic resource and their maintenance.
text.mr: राज्यातील मर्यादित सिंचन सुविधा लक्षात घेऊन, शाश्‍वत उत्‍पादनासाठी कोरडवाहू शेती तंत्रज्ञान विकसित करणे. मृद आणि जलसंधारणाच्या पध्दती, जमीन, पाऊसमान आणि हंगामानुसार पीक व्यवस्थापन, मध्य हंगाम दुरुस्ती, पडणाऱ्या पाऊस पाण्याचा अधिक कार्यक्षमतेने वापर, पिकांचे सुधारित वाण आणि पीक पध्दती विकसित करणे, शेतक-यांच्या गरजा लक्षात घेऊन विविध प्रकारची शेती औजारे व यंत्रे विकसीत करणे याविषयी बहुमोल संशोधनवर भर देण्‍यात येत आहे. गेल्या 53 वर्षात कृषि क्षेत्रात भरीव संशोधन करुन एकूण 270 वाण विकसीत केलेले आहेत. मृद व जलसंधारण, विविध पिके आणि पीक लागवड पध्दती, अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन, पाणी व्यवस्थापन, आंतरमशागत, तण, रोग आणि किडींचे एकात्मिक व्यवस्थापन, नियंत्रीत शेती, प्रक्रिया आणि विपणन  याविषयी सखोल संशोधन करुन विद्यापीठाने एकूण 1577 शिफारशी दिल्या आहेत. जैवतंत्रज्ञान, वनस्पती ऊती संवर्धन, अणुजीवशास्र, जैविक कीड नियंत्रण व जीवाणू खते निर्मिती याकडे विशेष लक्ष देण्यात येत आहे.

text.en: To develop technology with integrated pest, disease and nutrient management to increase production for making agricultural production cost effective and sustainable. To develop post-harvest technology for minimizing post-harvest losses and production of value-added products. To design and develop farm implements and technology for mechanization of agriculture. To evaluate and modify technology for protected cultivation of flowers and vegetables.
text.mr: तसेच विद्यापीठाचे भूषण असलेली फुले-त्रिवेणी ही तिहेरी संकरीत गाय, तिची दुध देण्याची क्षमता, वातावरणाशी जुळवून घेण्याची क्षमता व स्निग्धता इतर संकरित गायींपेक्षा जास्त आहे.विद्यापीठाने विकसीत केलेले लक्ष्मी विळा, ज्योती कांदा रोप लागवड यंत्र, ज्योती लसूण घास कापणी यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले सरीवरंबा बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले ऊस आंतरमशागत यंत्र, पॉवरटिलरचलित फुले बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, मनुष्यचलीत फुले भुईमूग शेंगा फोडणी आणि सफाई यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले मोल नांगर, बैलचलीत फुले बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, फुले सरीवरंबा बहुपीक टोकण यंत्र, ट्रॅक्टरचलित फुले ऊस आंतर मशागत यंत्र, मानवचलीत फुले ज्वारी काढणी यंत्र, मानवचलीत फुले औषधी बिया फोडणी यंत्र, विद्युतचलित फुले कडबा कुट्टी यंत्र, फुले पीव्हीसी भात लावणी चौकट व ट्रॅक्टरचलित ऊस बांधणी यंत्र या 35 सुधारित यंञे व औजारांमुळे शेतक-यांचे काबाड कष्ट कमी होवून मजुरांची बचत होत असल्याने शेतक-यांमध्ये ती लोकप्रिय आहेत.

text.en: Taking into consideration the availability of land, water and weather conditions and other existing resources, the university has concentrated its efforts to develop suitable technologies for dryland agriculture, irrigated farming as well as hi-tech agriculture. During the last 53 years, the University has developed about 39 different types of Farm Implements and Machineries for the ease of sowing, transplanting, burring, interculturing and harvesting operations on the farms and 270 improved / F1 hybrids varieties of field crops, forages, vegetables, horticultural and ornamental crops, cash crops, spices, aromatic and medicinal plants and also registered pure breeds of cattle-Khillar, goat-Osmanabadi & Sangamneri, sheep-Deccani and buffalo-Pandharpuri with NBAGR, Karnal, and one Phule Trivni cattle breed , etc. More than 1577 crop production technologies pertaining to agro-techniques, soil and water management, farming and cropping systems, integrated nutrient, water, pest, disease management, post harvest technology, farm machinery, etc are developed and recommended for productivity improvement. The university has focused its attention on location specific and need based research activities and also seed production and seedlings/saplings activities on large scale in order to cater the needs of all types of farmers and farming groups. Organic farming, crop diversification, development of transgenic and export oriented quality production and post harvest handling and process engineering are the priority areas to face the challenges of WTO regime. Biotechnology with its vast potential and challenges is important to agricultural development. This university is developing biotechnological competence in the areas of plant tissue culture, genetic engineering, molecular biology, and molecular characterization for IPR issues, biocontrol and biofertilizers.
text.mr: भारताची सतत वाढणारी लोकसंख्या तसेच,  भविष्यातील शेती ही पाणी टंचाई, हवामानातील बदल व जागतिकीकरण यांचा सर्वांगीण विचार करुन शाश्‍वत उत्पादनाची गरज भागविणारी आहे. याकरीता उपलब्ध नैसर्गिक साधनसंपत्तीचा सुयोग्य वापरावर आधारीत उत्पादकता वाढवणारी शेती पध्दतीची उभारणी, अन्नधान्यामध्ये स्वयंपूर्णता व निर्यातक्षम कृषिउत्पादने, शास्रज्ञ व तांत्रिक मनुष्यबळ निर्मिती ही देशातील कृषि विद्यापीठांची प्राथमिक ध्येय धोरणे आहेत. याशिवाय, प्रक्रिया, साठवण, शीतसाखळी, कृषिजन्य उत्पादनाची निर्यात या क्षेत्रात संशोधनाची गरज असणार आहे. हे ध्येय साध्य करण्यासाठी कृषि संशोधनाची धोरणे ठरवितांना सर्वोच्च उत्पादन आणि उत्पादकतेबरोबरच, उत्पादन खर्च कमी करुन उच्च गुणवत्तेचे कृषि उत्पादन मिळवण्यासाठी आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा समावेश करण्यावर भर देण्यात येत आहे.

text.en: The university has a very good network of 27 research stations spread over 5 different agro-climatic zones having 82 non-plan schemes funded by State Govt., 45 AICRPs on different crops /plant sciences and one Centrally Sponsored Research Schemes funded by the Central Govt., Ministry of Agriculture, where varietal development and technology verification of more than 100 crops (cereals, pulses, oilseeds, vegetable , cash crops protected cultivation , exotic vegetables and fruit crops) is being carried out. In addition to this management of natural resource management, development of integrated farming system model research is undertaken for the upliftment of resource poor farming community.
text.mr: पश्चिम महाराष्ट्रातील दहा जिल्हयांचा समावेश असलेले घाट विभाग, उप-पर्वतीय विभाग, मैदानी विभाग, अवर्षण प्रवण विभाग व मध्य महाराष्ट्रातील पठारी विभाग या 5 हवामान विभागात असलेली तृणधान्‍ये, कडधान्‍ये, गळीताची धान्‍ये, फळे-भाजीपाला, नगदी पिके, विदेशी भाजीपाला इत्‍यादी १०० हून अधिक पिकावर, मध्यवर्ती परिसरासह एकूण 27 संशोधन केंद्रावर असलेल्‍या राज्य शासन अनुदानित 82 योजनेतर योजना, भारतीय कृषि संशोधन परिषद (75 %) आणि राज्य शासन (25 %) अनुदानीत 45 अखिल भारतीय समन्वीत संशोधन प्रकल्प आणि केंद्र पुरस्कृत 100 टक्के अनुदानीत 1 संशोधन प्रकल्पामार्फत संशोधन केले जाते.

text.mr: राज्यातील मर्यादित सिंचन सुविधा लक्षात घेऊन, शाश्‍वत उत्‍पादनासाठी कोरडवाहू शेती तंत्रज्ञान विकसित करणे. मृद आणि जलसंधारणाच्या पध्दती, जमीन, पाऊसमान आणि हंगामानुसार पीक व्यवस्थापन, मध्य हंगाम दुरुस्ती, पडणाऱ्या पाऊस पाण्याचा अधिक कार्यक्षमतेने वापर, पिकांचे सुधारित वाण आणि पीक पध्दती विकसित करणे, शेतक-यांच्या गरजा लक्षात घेऊन विविध प्रकारची शेती औजारे व यंत्रे विकसीत करणे याविषयी बहुमोल संशोधनवर भर देण्‍यात येत आहे. गेल्या 53 वर्षात कृषि क्षेत्रात भरीव संशोधन करुन एकूण 270 वाण विकसीत केलेले आहेत. मृद व जलसंधारण, विविध पिके आणि पीक लागवड पध्दती, अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन, पाणी व्यवस्थापन, आंतरमशागत, तण, रोग आणि किडींचे एकात्मिक व्यवस्थापन, नियंत्रीत शेती, प्रक्रिया आणि विपणन  याविषयी सखोल संशोधन करुन विद्यापीठाने एकूण 1577 शिफारशी दिल्या आहेत. जैवतंत्रज्ञान, वनस्पती ऊती संवर्धन, अणुजीवशास्र, जैविक कीड नियंत्रण व जीवाणू खते निर्मिती याकडे विशेष लक्ष देण्यात येत आहे.

text.mr: भारताची सतत वाढणारी लोकसंख्या तसेच,  भविष्यातील शेती ही पाणी टंचाई, हवामानातील बदल व जागतिकीकरण यांचा सर्वांगीण विचार करुन शाश्‍वत उत्पादनाची गरज भागविणारी आहे. याकरीता उपलब्ध नैसर्गिक साधनसंपत्तीचा सुयोग्य वापरावर आधारीत उत्पादकता वाढवणारी शेती पध्दतीची उभारणी, अन्नधान्यामध्ये स्वयंपूर्णता व निर्यातक्षम कृषिउत्पादने, शास्रज्ञ व तांत्रिक मनुष्यबळ निर्मिती ही देशातील कृषि विद्यापीठांची प्राथमिक ध्येय धोरणे आहेत. याशिवाय, प्रक्रिया, साठवण, शीतसाखळी, कृषिजन्य उत्पादनाची निर्यात या क्षेत्रात संशोधनाची गरज असणार आहे. हे ध्येय साध्य करण्यासाठी कृषि संशोधनाची धोरणे ठरवितांना सर्वोच्च उत्पादन आणि उत्पादकतेबरोबरच, उत्पादन खर्च कमी करुन उच्च गुणवत्तेचे कृषि उत्पादन मिळवण्यासाठी आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा समावेश करण्यावर भर देण्यात येत आहे.

text.en: In accordance with the provisions under clause (V) of Section 29 of Statute No. 14 (I) of the Maharashtra Agriculture Universities, 1990, the "Agricultural Research Council" is constituted to serve as an advisory body on all the research matters of the university. The Council meets once in year. Vice Chancellor is the Ex officio Chairman and Director of Research is the Ex officio member secretary, Director of Instructions, Director of Extension Education, Commissioner of Agriculture and Animal Husbandary of Maharashtra State, Director of Horticulture, Fisheries of Maharashtra State, One Director of Research from other Agril. University and One Chief Research Officer from university are the members of the council, while Director (Research), MCAER, all Head of the Departments, all Associate Director of Research and all Crop specialists are the invitee members for the council. The council, serve as an advisory body on all the research matters of the university and advice Vice-Chancellor and Executive Council on all research matters. Also the council, review the research programmes, formulate research policies and make recommendations for provision of research facilities.
text.mr: In accordance with the provisions under clause (V) of Section 29 of Statute No. 14 (I) of the Maharashtra Agriculture Universities, 1990, the "Agricultural Research Council" is constituted to serve as an advisory body on all the research matters of the university. The Council meets once in year. Vice Chancellor is the Ex officio Chairman and Director of Research is the Ex officio member secretary, Director of Instructions, Director of Extension Education, Commissioner of Agriculture and Animal Husbandary of Maharashtra State, Director of Horticulture, Fisheries of Maharashtra State, One Director of Research from other Agril. University and One Chief Research Officer from university are the members of the council, while Director (Research), MCAER, all Head of the Departments, all Associate Director of Research and all Crop specialists are the invitee members for the council. The council, serve as an advisory body on all the research matters of the university and advice Vice-Chancellor and Executive Council on all research matters. Also the council, review the research programmes, formulate research policies and make recommendations for provision of research facilities.

text.en: The Groupwise Research Programme Planning meetings are organized every year in the month of February-March for the planning of new research programme to be implemented from the ensuring next year. Vice Chancellor is the Chairman, Director of Research is the Co-chairman and respective Head of the Department is the convener for the Research Programme Planning Meeting. Taking into the consideration of current need of farming community, state government and feedback from various line departments, Research programme of each scientist is examined and finalized in Research Programme Planning Meeting.

text.en: The Groupwise Research Review Committee meetings are organized every year in the month of January. Vice Chancellor is the Chairman, Director of Research is the Co-chairman and respective Head of the Department is the Convener for the Research Review Committee. Research Findings of the ongoing and completed research experiments are examined and recommended for release in Research Review Committee meeting.
text.mr: The Groupwise Research Review Committee meetings are organized every year in the month of January. Vice Chancellor is the Chairman, Director of Research is the Co-chairman and respective Head of the Department is the Convener for the Research Review Committee. Research Findings of the ongoing and completed research experiments are examined and recommended for release in Research Review Committee meeting.

text.en: State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra and Maharashtra Council of Agriculture Education and Research (MCAER) are jointly organizing 'Joint AGRESCO' once in year (in the month of May) on rotational basis. The Pro Chancellor of State Agriculture University is the chairman and Vice Chancellors of all four State Agricultural Universities in Maharashtra are the Co-Chairman for the 'Joint AGRESCO'. The technologies passed in Research Review Meeting are reviewed for release in 'Joint AGRESCO' meet.
